name: Weather Prime
description:
Weather Prime brings a polished, full-featured weather station to your GNOME top bar. A clean pill shows current conditions at a glance, and a single click opens a rich, tabbed drop-down packed with everything from live radar to moon phases.

☀️ CURRENT CONDITIONS
• Temperature, feels-like, humidity, wind, and barometric pressure
• A smart pressure-trend arrow that hints at incoming weather
• Dew point, wind gusts, visibility, cloud cover, and last-24h rainfall

📈 FORECASTS
• Hourly — a 12-hour outlook with temperature, precipitation chance, humidity, and wind
• 7-Day — daily highs and lows, precipitation, humidity, and wind

🌬️ AIR QUALITY
• Pick AirNow (US EPA AQI per pollutant), OpenWeatherMap (global 1–5 AQI plus all eight pollutants), or Open-Meteo PM2.5 / PM10
• Automatic source fallback so you always see a reading

🌙 ASTRONOMY
• Sunrise and sunset, moonrise and moonset, moon phase, and illumination
• Solar noon plus the dates of the next new and full moon (keyless USNO data)

🗺️ LIVE RADAR MAP
• Animated RainViewer precipitation radar layered over Esri satellite imagery
• One click launches Windy, Zoom Earth, Ventusky, RainViewer, Weather.com, Wunderground, or NWS Radar for full interactivity

⚠️ SEVERE-WEATHER ALERTS
• Live NWS alerts surface automatically for US locations, complete with the full alert text

⚙️ MADE YOUR WAY
• Auto-locate via GeoClue2, or set your spot manually with built-in city search
• Theme follows your system light/dark setting — or pin it the way you like
• Panel sits left, center, or right at original, medium (1.25×), or large (1.5×) size
• Independently configurable refresh cadence for weather, air quality, and radar

✨ Works out of the box — no API keys, no signup, no fees. Optional free keys from WeatherAPI.com, WeatherAI.io, AirNow, and OpenWeatherMap unlock the extra providers whenever you want them.
